# Where to Watch Lily's Lab


by Angel | September 16, 2026


Kids ask questions. Lots of them. Why is the sky blue? How did dinosaurs live? What makes plants grow? Sometimes, their questions are easy to answer. Other times, they can leave even the most prepared parent searching for the right words.


That’s where Lily comes in.


*Lily’s Lab* follows Lily the Leaellynasaura, a curious, truth-loving dinosaur who isn’t afraid to dig a little deeper. In each episode, Lily explores one of life’s most perplexing questions, starting with the truth of the Bible and using logic, curiosity, and age-appropriate explanations to explore the answers.


[Watch Season 1 of Lily’s Lab now on Angel.](https://www.angel.com/watch/lilys-lab)


### **A Dinosaur With a Lot of Questions**


Lily isn’t content to simply accept an answer. She wants to know why.


Her curiosity drives each episode as she investigates questions about the world around her. Along the way, she looks to the Bible as her starting point for truth, then explores each topic in a way that makes complex ideas easier to understand.


That combination gives the series a distinct approach to science, creation, and big questions. Rather than treating curiosity as something to outgrow, *Lily’s Lab* embraces it as part of the learning process.


### **Big Questions, Age-Appropriate Answers**


Some questions are surprisingly difficult to explain, especially when they come from curious kids who want to understand how things work.


*Lily’s Lab* breaks those questions down into explanations that are accessible for young audiences. One Angel Guild member praised the series for its approach, saying, “The explanations are age-appropriate and broken down with both biblical support and logic that kids can understand.”


Each episode gives Lily another opportunity to investigate, learn, and uncover an answer. The result is a series that encourages thoughtful questions while grounding its answers in a Christian worldview.


### **Learning Through Curiosity**


Every episode brings a new question and a new opportunity for discovery. That variety is part of what keeps the series fresh.


As another Angel Guild member put it, “I love how every episode is a little different and unique.”


That makes *Lily’s Lab* more than a collection of lessons. It’s a series built around the natural curiosity that drives kids to ask questions in the first place. And Lily’s enthusiasm for finding answers makes her an engaging guide along the way.


### **A Fresh Take on Biblical Learning**


For families looking for educational entertainment rooted in biblical truth, *Lily’s Lab* offers a colorful and approachable option.


The animation gives the series a playful, modern feel, while its focus on Scripture, logic, and discovery gives each episode substance.


At the center of it all is Lily: a little dinosaur with a big appetite for answers.


### **Watch** ***Lily’s Lab*** **on Angel**


With colorful animation, approachable explanations, and a dinosaur who’s always searching for the next answer, *Lily’s Lab* makes discovery part of the adventure.
